subject: Request for VP/CFO signoff: SurgeonAI volume-ladder rebate and ramp credits
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SurgeonAI: request for exception — stepped volume rebate + ramp credits

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Quick background: SurgeonAI (Series B robotics company) is asking for a stepped volume rebate that effectively increases discounts as they hit usage milestones over the first 12 months (0–1M tokens: standard price; 1M–5M: 12% rebate; >5M: 18% rebate). They also want a 30-day ramp credit to offset onboarding inference costs.

This ask sits outside our commercial guardrails (total effective discount could exceed 22% at scale and the ramp credit is a nonstandard credit line). Jordan and the account team recommend granting a limited, time-boxed exception conditioned on:
- 12-month term only
- Cap rebates to $120k total payout
- Prepay of first 3 months or automatic monthly invoicing with revenue-stabilization clause

Attached: initial MAP and proposed SOW (draft v2).

Can you advise whether we should surface this to VP/CFO for signoff? If yes, I can draft a one-page memo with ACV, margin impact, and suggested contract language.

Asks: quick yes/no on escalation and any immediate redlines we should bake into the memo.

Thanks,
Jordan
--
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SurgeonAI: request for exception — stepped volume rebate + ramp credits

Jordan — thanks for the summary. Escalate to VP/CFO.

Couple of immediate constraints from my side:
1) Any rebate that scales with usage must have a hard cap and a clear reconciliation cadence (quarterly).
2) Ramp credits should be applied as one-time invoice credits applied only if onboarding milestones are met — not automatic refunds.
3) No changes to standard termination for convenience without proportional repayment language.

Marissa — can you/finance run a quick delta to our forecast showing: incremental churn-adjusted margin impact over 12 months and worst-case payout schedule? Karthik, loop legal on the repayment clause wording.

If we escalate, Jordan please include: ACV, estimated token curve, projected month-by-month spend, and why SurgeonAI is strategic (technical references or partner tie-ins). We should be conservative with precedent.

Soojin
--
Soojin Lee | Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SurgeonAI: request for exception — stepped volume rebate + ramp credits

Thanks — Jordan please send the ACV and month-by-month token curve by EOD so I can model three scenarios (baseline / adoption / downside).

Initial ask for modeling assumptions:
- Base price used for calculation: Standard hosted list (per-token)
- Conservative adoption: 40% of forecasted token volume
- Upside: 90% of forecasted token volume
- Rebate payout schedule: quarterly reconciliation with 45-day settlement window

If the upside scenario results in >15% margin erosion, I will require a reduced rebate cap (recommend $90k) or additional protections (eg. min commitment or monthly minimum invoice).

I can prepare a one-page memo for VP/CFO signoff once I have the numbers. Also confirm the legal clause we want for repayment on early termination.

- Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | VP, Finance (Interim CFO)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SurgeonAI: request for exception — stepped volume rebate + ramp credits

Marissa / Soojin — attaching the requested items. Highlights below:

ACV: $420,000 (year 1)
Estimated monthly token curve (conservative / expected / upside): attached spreadsheet; expected hits 3.2M tokens by month 6, 6.6M by month 10.
Requested economics:
- Stepped rebate as proposed (12% after 1M, 18% after 5M) capped at $120k total rebate
- 30-day onboarding credit of up to $25k applied after successful completion of integration milestones (integration test, latency target met, and production inference sample test).
- Customer willing to sign a 12-month term and provide a 3-month prepayment as assurance.

Customer notes: SurgeonAI is integrating Redwood into their surgical-assist product and has partnership discussions with a major med-device OEM. They requested speed on contracting (they want to be live in Q3). Procurement asked for an written commercial exception that a VP/CFO signs.

Attachments: SurgeonAI_MutualActionPlan_20270613.xlsx; SurgeonAI_Proposed_SOW_v2.pdf

Jordan
--
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: APPROVAL: SurgeonAI limited commercial exception (VP/CFO signoff)

Folks — after modeling the scenarios I approve a limited exception with the following binding conditions. This memo serves as VP/CFO signoff for legal to incorporate the commercial terms into the SOW/Order Form.

Decision: APPROVE commercial exception (one-time limited approval).

Conditions (must be included in contract):
1) Term: 12 months only; automatic conversion to standard pricing thereafter.
2) Rebate: stepped ladder (12% after 1M tokens; 18% after 5M tokens) with an absolute rebate cap of $100,000 (reduced from the ask to control downside).
3) Payout: Quarterly reconciliation; 45-day settlement window. Rebate payments issued as credits on invoice only.
4) Ramp credit: capped at $20,000, paid as one-time invoice credit upon verification of the three onboarding milestones in the attached MAP.
5) Prepay: Customer must prepay first 3 months (applied to invoices) — or provide an irrevocable letter of credit to the same value.
6) Early termination: Pro-rata clawback of unreconciled rebate amounts; customer owes any rebate paid in excess of earned usage. If the customer terminates for convenience, outstanding rebates become due within 30 days.
7) Legal: Legal to add explicit repayment/overpayment clause and include audit rights for 18 months.
8) Exec visibility: This approval is one-off and must not be used as precedent. Commercial must notify Finance before executing any follow-on variation.

Next steps: Legal to draft contract language and circulate via DocuSign. Jordan — confirm customer accepts the reduced cap and prepay within 24 hours so legal can prioritize.

Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | VP, Finance (Interim CFO)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: SurgeonAI_rebate_model_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)
